title: The First Domino Hasn't Fallen
speaker: Figuring Out Money host

macro_themes.view: S&P has ~3-5% upside left to ~8,000-8,100 (JPM collar 8,060) in a seasonally bullish Q4, but downside opens up if it loses the gamma flip; weekly momentum is slowing.
At big tops yields peak first; yields still making highs so stocks can run, but a yield roll-over would be a warning. 2026 yield run mirrors the 2018 midterm analog.
TLT at new lows; S&P/TLT relative RSI frothy (81.5), which in the past preceded consolidation.
Goldman risk-appetite factor at -8; if yields back off, real estate, utilities, Russell and homebuilders could snap back; NYSE breadth deeply washed out.
